description.value:
Requirements You have a free hand and are holding a battery with at least 10 charges.

With a couple quick adjustments, you Craft an electromag grenade using the held battery. The grenade is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Electromag Grenade (Commercial)]{Commercial} grade if the battery has at least 10 charges, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Electromag Grenade (Tactical)]{Tactical} if the battery has at least 40 charges, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Electromag Grenade (Advanced)]{Advanced} if the battery has at least 60 charges. If you're legendary in Crafting, you can Craft a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Electromag Grenade (Superior)]{Superior} grenade using a battery with at least 100 charges. Grenades crafted using Akiton Battery Hack last until the end of your next turn, after which they're harmlessly discharged and no longer function as a battery or grenade.
